caption: The drawing depicts a single object positioned centrally on a light beige or off-white background, taking up most of the vertical space. The object is a trivet made of metal, featuring a pointed oval or teardrop shape with a flat base, and is rendered in shades of brown and gray to simulate metallic coloring. The trivet consists of ornate, symmetrical scrollwork with looping, curved elements, and several small branched protrusions within the open framework. There are three short, solid legs supporting the trivet, two nearer the back and one at the front. The drawing is detailed and precise, emphasizing the contours and intricate internal design of the object. The artist’s signature, “Glenn L. Wilson,” appears in red in small script near the lower right corner of the paper.
title: Trivet
